entries.t: <FACE:9C>Did that person really<NL>say <PLAYER>?<WAIT><FACE:99>What!? Is that guy<NL>really that famous?
<FACE:9C>They say he fixed the<NL>big meltdown here!<WAIT>Once that gets around,<NL>he'll be famous!
<FACE:99>Huh, if he's that good<NL>I want a rematch!
<FACE:02>We meet again, guys!
<FACE:99>Oh! <PLAYER>, right?<NL><WAIT>I hear you're a pretty<NL>famous Medafighter<WAIT>Let's Robattle again!<WAIT><FACE:00>Sure… but about what<NL>they just said…
<FACE:9C>Hey, hey, let teacher<NL>in on that Robattle!
<FACE:99>Whaaat!<NL><WAIT>With a teacher along<NL>you'd slow us down!

<FACE:99>Huh! You don't mean<NL>Rintaro!?
<FACE:00>What?<NL>Rintaro's coming too?

<FACE:99>Then it's settled!<NL>Let's Robattle now!
<FACE:9C>Waaah… I lost…
<FACE:99>See, with the teacher<NL>as leader…
<FACE:9C>But…!<NL><WAIT>I wanted some clout so<NL>students respect me!
<FACE:00>So… I've got something<NL>to ask Rintaro…
<FACE:9C>…Sniff… Huh? Rintaro…<NL>…hold on a moment…
<FACE:9C>Helloo…<NL>Oh!? The link's cut…<WAIT>He says he's busy…
<FACE:99>Bah, knowing him,<NL>he's out somewhere<WAIT>Robattling like crazy!<WAIT><FACE:04>…I see…
<FACE:00>If you see him, tell<NL>him I was looking
<FACE:99>Tch, fine…<NL>You owe me a match!<WAIT><FACE:00>Sure<NL>And also…<WAIT>It's Ms. Tamao, right?<NL><WAIT>Do you know someone<NL>named Hikaru?
<FACE:9C>Hikaru? The one that<NL>Rintaro looks up to?<WAIT>I saw him in a room<NL>a lot like this one<WAIT>I just can't recall<NL>where…
<FACE:02>Really!? I'll go check<NL>the other rooms!<WAIT>Thank you!
